name: Tofu Bhurji Breakfast
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, drained and crumbled
steps: Pat tofu dry and crumble into small pieces with a fork.
Heat oil in a skillet. Add cumin and onion; cook 2 minutes until translucent.
Add tomato, turmeric and coriander powder; cook until tomato softens.
Add spinach and cook until wilted. Fold in tofu and garam masala.
Cook 3–4 minutes, stirring gently. Finish with coriander and lemon; serve with one small whole-wheat roti.
note: Choose calcium-set tofu where available. Nutrition estimate covers the tofu bhurji only, not the optional roti.
